title: 第15章 老师第16章 深渊魔法
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: “什么？”
宁语以为自己听错了。
可还没等她问清楚情况，就被珲伍一脚踹了下去。
“等会儿！
我现在没办法施法的……”
她尖叫了一声，直接落向了谷底。
宁语确实没有说谎，先前接连不断地施展【血刃】术已经把她体内仅存的魔力耗空了，在没有摄入药剂补充的情况下，这会儿蓝条还是干的，无法再施展出腾空的术法。
然而尖叫之余，她忽然发现自己下落的速度非但没有增快，反而逐渐慢了下来。
谷底下方不断有气流喷涌向上，托住了她的体重，使得整个下落的过程变得很慢。
最终落地的时候虽然栽了一跟头，却完全没有受伤，甚至都达不到平地摔的程度。
在宁语落地之后没多久，珲伍身形也从上方坠了下来，平稳落地。
宁语爬起身，惊讶地问道：
“您怎么知道这有一个上升气流的？”
珲伍抓了一把湿漉漉的杂草抹去脸上的血水，径直朝前方谷底走去。
宁语翻开背包掏出一个蓝色的小玻璃瓶，将瓶子里的药剂倒入口中。
酸辣的药剂入喉，她的脸上很快挤出一副痛苦面具。
不过很快她就又可以施展术法了，小跑着跟上了珲伍的步伐，从术法典籍中抽出一枚符文抛向上空。
符文泛起荧光，在漆黑的谷底中提供了小幅度的光亮，一路跟随在他们二人的正上方。
这一路走来，珲伍习惯了宁语各种絮絮叨叨的问题，而宁语也习惯了珲伍无视自己的絮絮叨叨。
不过跟随着珲伍的步伐逐渐深入谷底，在看到龙墓谷底的真正景象时，她终于是震惊得连话都说不出来了。
深入谷底没有多久，视野豁然开朗。
虽然深处于地下，但周遭环境中凝聚着各种璀璨荧光，搭配上谷底那仿若被灼烧过的黑色内壁，使身处其中的人感觉自己就好似漫步在星空之下，甚至犹有过之。
宁语的照明术法也用不着了。
这里四周灰蓝色的光照非常充足，一些石壁高处还挂有火盆在持续燃烧着，在整体的冷色调的背景下开辟出一条暖色光路线，类似于某种指引。
沿途可以看到有许多的骸骨堆积，那里面除了人族之外还有其他许多无法辨认的物种，大部分都已经风化。
同样是寂静无人的区域，但龙墓谷底却透着一股不同于迷魅森林的森然。
就如珲伍认知中那般，迷魅森林是自家客厅，再往外走所能够遇到的地图都是充斥着恶意的。
龙墓谷底，也差不多是这么个地方。
“原来是真的……”
宁语看着越是深入越发深邃的谷底环境，恍然感慨。
“这里是龙帝国王城的遗址，王朝陨落之后，大陆上依旧保留着对龙族的信仰，我之前看过一本关于龙飨信仰的禁忌册子，写的就是龙飨祷告的传播以及祭祀仪式，说只要到龙墓之下进行侍奉和献祭，就有机会成为龙，我本以为当时看的是盗版书籍…”
现在，看着谷底阴暗角落里堆积着的这些骸骨，宁语忽然明白，自己当年无意间看到的那本宣传册子有可能是正版。
正版的**。
content_en:
"What?"
Ning Yu thought she heard wrongly.
But before she could ask clearly about the situation, she was kicked by Hui Wu.
"Wait a minute!
I can't cast a spell now..."
She screamed and fell directly to the bottom.
Ning Yu was indeed not lying. The continuous use of the [Blood Blade] technique previously had exhausted the remaining magic power in her body. Without taking in the medicine to replenish it, the blue strips were still dry at this moment and could no longer perform the soaring technique.
However, while screaming, she suddenly found that instead of increasing in speed, her falling speed gradually slowed down.
There was constant airflow under the valley bottom, which supported her weight and made the entire falling process very slow.
Although he stumbled when he finally landed, he was not injured at all, not even to the extent of falling flat on the ground.
Not long after Ning Yu landed, Hui Wu also fell from above and landed smoothly.
Ning Yu climbed up and asked in surprise:
"How do you know there's an updraft here?"
Hui Wu grabbed a handful of wet weeds to wipe the blood from his face, and walked straight to the bottom of the valley ahead.
Ning Yu opened her backpack and took out a small blue glass bottle, pouring the medicine in the bottle into her mouth.
The sour and spicy potion entered her throat, and a mask of pain quickly formed on her face.
But soon she was able to cast spells again, trotting to keep up with Hui Wu, pulling out a rune from the spell book and throwing it into the sky.
The runes glowed with fluorescence, providing a small amount of light in the dark valley bottom, following directly above the two of them.
Along the way, Hui Wu got used to Ning Yu's nagging questions, and Ning Yu also got used to Hui Wu ignoring her nagging questions.
However, following Hui Wu's steps, she gradually went deeper into the valley. When she saw the real scene at the bottom of the Dragon Tomb Valley, she was finally so shocked that she couldn't even speak.
Not long after reaching the bottom of the valley, the vision suddenly opened up.
Although it is deep underground, the surrounding environment is condensed with various bright fluorescent lights, and combined with the burnt black inner walls of the valley bottom, people inside feel as if they are walking under the stars, or even worse.
Ning Yu's lighting technique is no longer needed.
There is plenty of gray-blue light all around here, and there are fire pots hung high on some stone walls that are burning continuously, creating a route of warm light against the overall cold-toned background, which is similar to some kind of guidance.
Along the way, you can see many piles of skeletons. In addition to humans, there are many other unidentifiable species, most of which have weathered.
It is also a quiet and uninhabited area, but the bottom of Dragon Tomb Valley has a sense of forest that is different from the enchanted forest.
Just as Hui Wu believed, the Enchanted Forest is his living room, and the maps he encounters when he goes outside are full of malicious intentions.
The bottom of Dragon Tomb Valley is almost the same place.
"It turns out it's true..."
Ning Yu suddenly sighed as she looked at the deeper and deeper valley environment.
"This is the site of the Dragon Empire's royal city. After the fall of the dynasty, the mainland still retains its belief in dragons. I have read a taboo book about the belief in Dragon Feast before. It talks about the spread of Dragon Feast prayers and sacrificial rituals. It says that as long as you serve and sacrifice under the dragon's tomb, you have a chance to become a dragon. I thought I was reading a pirated book..."
Now, looking at the skeletons piled up in a dark corner at the bottom of the valley, Ning Yu suddenly understood that the brochure she accidentally saw back then might be genuine.
Genuine**.
